subject: Human Evolution
title: Atlatl: The Spear Thrower
description: A quick, practical guide to Atlatl: The Spear Thrower.

hook.text: An atlatl is a stick that launches a spear twice as far and three times as hard as an unaided arm.

buildup.text: By extending the lever arm, the atlatl multiplies the thrower's force—simple physics, deadly results.

discovery.text: Atlatls appear in the archaeological record by at least 30,000 years ago across multiple continents.

twist.text: They let hunters wound from a safe distance—critical when facing tusked or horned megafauna.

climax.text: The atlatl was the first projectile amplifier—an ancestor of the bow, the gun, and the missile.

punchline.text: A simple stick made us lethal at distance.

quiz.question: How does an atlatl improve spear throwing?
options: It extends the lever arm, increasing range and force
